# Stuntman

> The stunt double for every provider your app calls: SMS, WhatsApp, email (SMTP, SendGrid, IMAP, POP3), storage
> (Azure Blob, S3), file servers (FTP, FTPS, SFTP), queues (Service Bus, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ over OpenWire), Kafka
> and Schema Registry, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, Amazon Kinesis, Azure Event Hubs, identity (OIDC, OAuth2, SAML, LDAP, Bot Framework), secrets, AI model APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic,
> Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek), product analytics (PostHog, Segment, Mixpanel, GA4), webhooks, telemetry (OTLP,
> GELF, StatsD) and any REST, GraphQL or SOAP API. It answers like the provider, keeps state, sends callbacks and
> fails on cue. Every action (388 tools) is an MCP tool (streamable HTTP at /mcp) and an HTTP route under /api. Open
> source, Apache-2.0.

To set Stuntman up for a project, read and follow the agent setup guide step by step:

- [Agent setup guide](https://edivanteixeira.github.io/stuntman/agent-setup.md): start it, connect, find providers, configure, verify, welcome

## Notes for agents

- Found something Stuntman gets wrong or lacks? Suggest the fix to the developer and offer to send it as a pull
  request to https://github.com/edivanteixeira/stuntman (CONTRIBUTING.md); only after a yes, with nothing from their
  project in it.
- Service Bus: AMQP on :5673 (TLS :5671); the administration client (management over HTTP/HTTPS) and AMQP on :5300,
  as the official emulator. Without a port in the connection string, .NET/JS management goes to :80: publish
  `-p 127.0.0.1:80:5300` or add `:5300` to the string.
- Test CA: `get_test_ca`, or `/api/test-ca.pem`, `.crt`, `.p12` (password changeit). Trust it per process; ask the
  developer before adding it to an OS trust store.

## Image

- Docker Hub: edivanteixeira/stuntman (linux/amd64, linux/arm64)
